title: Implement Robust Request Body Parsing
description: This feature improves performance and stability by handling various request body formats, including JSON, URL-encoded, and multipart/form-data, allowing for more flexible and robust API development. It will provide automatic parsing and error handling for invalid or malformed requests. This enhancement will significantly improve the overall user experience and API reliability.
testCases: Test error handling for invalid requests
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass and the API can handle different request body formats without errors.
reason: This feature is essential for a production-ready framework, as it directly impacts the reliability and flexibility of APIs built with yantraverse, aligning with the framework's focus on stability and performance.
